newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain estimates May CPI 1.5 pct yr/yr-Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain estimates May CPI 1.5 pct yr/yr-Montoro.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday that the Economy Ministry expects May consumer price inflation to have risen at a 1.5 percent rate year-on-year.

"The Economy Ministry's estimate is that in May the year-on-year rate continued a downtrend to reach around 1.5 percent which means that the rate was very moderate and that guarantees the meeting of the year-end target we recently revised," Montoro told journalists.
The Spanish government recently revised down its 1997 year-end inflation target to 2.2 percent from 2.6 percent.
May CPI data is due for release on Friday.
April CPI rose 1.7 percent year on year.
